verdict.rationale: Lago documents some of its own export paths: analytics dashboards can be exported to CSV, invoices can be downloaded, and a self-hosted Docker deployment keeps billing data on your own infrastructure. Nothing documents a complete, all-data export or a migration/offboarding path, so the 'export everything and leave' story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export (customers, subscriptions, events, plans) in open formats, an explicit migration or offboarding guide, independent corroboration of leaving with your data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Build custom dashboards per customer, filter any way you want and export to CSV.
You can download invoices or use the invoice object to create your own invoice template.
Docker is the easiest way to get started with the self-hosted version of Lago.
